title: Great guide, fascinating history
text: Elena was our exceptional guide for this fascinating tour of the Old Town after dark. The history was really interesting (and gory in places!) and it was great being in a very small group with a very knowledgeable guide. Thanks Elena for your tip of Bar Jai-Ca, we had a fantastic lunch there (with Bombas, of course!).
author: Mistystan

title: Great!!
text: Great!!, both the tour itself and the guide, she is very friendly and knows a lot and can also tell it in a fun and engaging way! Interactive and using, for example, a mini-projector so that it comes more alive. It's a real shame and actually incomprehensible that it isn't listed much 'higher' in the activities list; I almost overlooked it myself, but I know that many people will really appreciate this tour.
author: 107karimc

title: Couldn’t have asked for a better tour
text:
We had such a great time on the Dark Past Night walking tour. The absolute highlight for us was our guide, Elena. She was incredibly knowledgeable and had such a genuine passion for history—you could tell she absolutely loved sharing the cities history with us, which made the whole experience so fun and engaging. 

Elena also shared loads of fantastic local recommendations and insider tips that we ended up using for the rest of our trip. She was such a warm, friendly person that it honestly felt like we were exploring Barcelona with a friend.

author: keaveyn

title: Great history lesson from Elena
text: Elena was our guide, deeply knowledgeable about the history of Spain, particularly the Inquisition.  She engaged the group from the start, getting to know each of us and showing sincere interest in our backgrounds and what drew us to the tour.  In my book, this tour is under-priced for its value.  Thank you, Elena, for a fun and memorable tour!
